maize cercospora leaf spot.symptoms: Small tan to gray lesions with reddish-brown margins, often rectangular because they follow leaf veins; lesions can merge and kill leaf tissue.
maize cercospora leaf spot.treatment: Confirm the diagnosis and crop growth stage before treatment. Use resistant hybrids, manage infected residue, and apply only a locally approved fungicide when risk and label directions justify it.
maize cercospora leaf spot.prevention: Plant resistant hybrids, rotate away from maize where practical, manage crop residue, and scout lower leaves before lesions spread into the upper canopy.
maize cercospora leaf spot.source_note: General extension-style information; verify product approvals, dosage, and pre-harvest interval locally.

maize common rust.symptoms: Small cinnamon to dark brown rust-colored pustules on both leaf surfaces; severe infection can reduce green leaf area.
maize common rust.treatment: Remove volunteer maize and manage crop residue. Use a locally approved fungicide only when disease risk and crop growth stage justify it, following the product label and local extension guidance.
maize common rust.prevention: Plant resistant varieties where available, rotate crops, and scout lower leaves regularly.
maize common rust.source_note: General extension-style information; verify product approvals and diagnosis locally.

maize northern leaf blight.symptoms: Long gray-green to tan cigar-shaped lesions that expand along maize leaves.
maize northern leaf blight.treatment: Use resistant varieties and crop rotation. Fungicide decisions should be based on confirmed diagnosis, growth stage, disease risk, and the local product label.
maize northern leaf blight.prevention: Use resistant hybrids, bury or manage infected residue where practical, and scout before the upper canopy is affected.
maize northern leaf blight.source_note: General extension-style information; verify product approvals and diagnosis locally.

potato early blight.symptoms: Brown to black circular lesions, often with concentric rings, beginning on older leaves.
potato early blight.treatment: Remove heavily affected foliage where practical and maintain balanced irrigation and nutrition. Use only a locally approved fungicide according to its label and resistance-management guidance.
potato early blight.prevention: Use certified seed, rotate away from potato and tomato, and avoid prolonged leaf wetness.
potato early blight.source_note: General extension-style information; verify product approvals and diagnosis locally.

potato late blight.symptoms: Water-soaked or olive-brown lesions that can expand rapidly in cool, wet conditions; white growth may occur on leaf undersides.
potato late blight.treatment: Treat as urgent: isolate the affected area, avoid moving wet foliage, and contact local extension services. Use only an approved product and label program for the region.
potato late blight.prevention: Use certified seed, resistant varieties where available, field sanitation, and weather-based scouting.
potato late blight.source_note: General extension-style information; verify product approvals and diagnosis locally.
